rules.name: side
rules.rule: s = 1 when the country is the fixture's second side (+6), else 0

rules.name: headline by result
rules.rule: fixture +3 = s: a win; +3 = 2: a draw; otherwise a defeat. A win of kind 0xCB, 0x67, 0xC9, 0x65 or 0xC8 has a fixed headline; another win with margin 0 (1771:5C60) a fixed one; otherwise the top scoring slot's goals (1, 2, 3, other) choose the form, with one draw of 06B1(4) for 1 and 2

rules.name: penalty defeat
rules.rule: a defeat with equal goals (fixture +1 = +0) has a fixed headline and never reads the sack score

rules.name: sack score
rules.rule: 0B77: 0 when game +0x38 < 2 (unsigned word), or kind = 1, or (1771:59D8 and game +1 + m != 0), or country +0xBE != 0; otherwise cbw of [A91F] + 3 (country +0x2E) + 2

rules.name: sack thresholds
rules.rule: on a defeat with unequal goals: score -7 or -6 one headline, -10..-8 another, -255..-11 (signed; a byte gives -128..-11) the sack: 4E0E's bp-2 := 1; any other score (-5..127, or below -255: none) the plain defeat forms

rules.name: sack
rules.rule: after the news pages and the key wait, a set flag calls unmanage_country(m): game +0x47+m := 1; manager entry +1 := 1; BC5D(c); slots 12..20 position +6 := +7; the 80 pool players' +0 := 0; c +0x2E := c; c's 0xFE fixtures from the first nonzero list position := 0xFF
